title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 15

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the traceability briefing take place?
tasks.audioText: The quality manager will explain component traceability during a briefing on Monday at two fifteen. Students should meet in the quality office training room. The briefing will show how part numbers, batch records and inspection documents are linked. A sample traceability form will be provided, and students will complete a short matching exercise in pairs.

The quality manager will explain component traceability during a briefing on Monday at two fifteen. Students should meet in the quality office training room. The briefing will show how part numbers, batch records and inspection documents are linked. A sample traceability form will be provided, and students will complete a short matching exercise in pairs.
options: In the quality office training room

tasks.prompt: Traceability allows an organisation to follow a component through relevant stages of receipt, storage, inspection and use. A unique part number identifies the item, while a batch number may link it to a particular production group. Inspection records provide evidence of checks that have been completed. If a problem is reported later, these records can help staff identify which items may be affected. Reading 1. What does a batch number identify?
How can inspection records help when a problem is reported?
options: They help staff identify which items may be affected

tasks.prompt: Each component ___ to the relevant inspection record.
Choose TWO records that support component traceability.
The ability to follow a component's history through records is called ___.
You cannot find the inspection record for a component. What should you ask?
options: I will create a record from memory.
Could you help me locate the correct inspection record for this part number?
I will use another component's document.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of component traceability in a logical order.
options: Identify the component by its part number
Confirm the records refer to the same item
correctOrder: Identify the component by its part number
Confirm the records refer to the same item

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how part numbers, batch records and inspection documents support component traceability.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
